input.answer: Canada's overall consumer prices (CPI all-items, not seasonally adjusted) rose 3.1% in September 2026 from September 2025. The index went from 164.9 to 170.0. The arithmetic is (170.0 − 164.9) / 164.9 = 5.1 / 164.9 ≈ 3.09%, which rounds to 3.1%. I computed this from the index levels.
